core_equations.expression: S = int d^4x sqrt(-g) [ F R/2 - (grad phi)^2/2 - (grad chi_A)^2/2 - V ], F = xi_phi phi^2 + xi_chi X, V = (lambda_chi/4)(X - (alpha/lambda_chi) phi^2)^2 + (beta/4) phi^4, X = |chi|^2
F G_mn = T^phi_mn + T^chi_mn + (nabla_m nabla_n - g_mn box) F
box phi + xi_phi phi R - dV/dphi = 0
box chi_A + xi_chi R chi_A - 2 (dV/dX) chi_A = 0

unit_system: natural units hbar = c = 1; no dimensionful parameter; <phi> sets the unit (M_Pl^2 = xi_phi <phi>^2 + xi_chi <X>)

fields_parameters.meaning: dilaton = UET response scalar Phi (psi of v1)
O(2) matter doublet (UET C in phase/charge lanes)
curvature coupling of phi; replaces 1/kappa and xi_c of v1
curvature coupling of chi (new; generated at one loop in v1, wave B1)
quartic portal phi^2 |chi|^2; replaces g_c of v1

nearest_known_class.name: Higgs-dilaton model / induced gravity with a scale-invariant two-scalar potential
references: M. Shaposhnikov and D. Zenhausern, Phys. Lett. B 671, 162 (2009)
J. Garcia-Bellido, J. Rubio, M. Shaposhnikov and D. Zenhausern, Phys. Rev. D 84, 123504 (2011), arXiv:1107.2163
nearest_known_class.variable_map: phi = dilaton; chi_A = Higgs-like field but O(2) with 2 components instead of an SU(2) doublet

redundant_parameters.absorbed_by: canonical normalization and shift, as in v1

predictions.observable: no fifth force from the dilaton (derivative coupling in the Einstein frame, literature)
m_chi^2 / M_Pl^2 = 2 alpha / (xi_phi + xi_chi alpha / lambda_chi)
w(a): exactly -1 with ordinary gravity; w0 > -1 possible with unimodular gravity

lane_mappings.standard_quantity: global O(2) Noether charge density N^0 (conditional)
